model_backfill_note: The `model` field on B1 and R1, and the top-level `solo_justification` string, were both added on 2026-09-28 to satisfy the required-model and solo-justification rules in docs/CLAUDE_TEAM_LEAD.md (scripts/team_plan_check.cjs now fails a plan with a missing model, and a single builder spanning 2+ areas with no solo_justification). Neither field was recorded when this plan ran; both are inferred: opus for B1 because it is agent claude-lead, sonnet for R1 as an ordinary non-senior review, and the solo_justification is drawn from this plan's own scope/DoD text below, not from any new fact.
solo_justification: B1's own scope and DoD require styles.css, brand assets, the asset-render script and the pinned visual_brand_consistency_validation.ts test to change together as one atomic token set ('every text token >= 4.5:1', 'no class/testid/prop/logic change', 'style-pinning suites green'); splitting the stylesheet from its renderer script or its pinned test across parallel writers risks a token value none of the others agree on, so PROJECT_STATUS.md and the plan file ride along with the same single owner.
retroactive_finding_note: Running the current checker on this file reports `senior_review_missing` for B1 (`touches ci-gates; an independent reviewer with senior: true is required before merge`), so it prints TEAM_PLAN_FAIL. That finding is retroactive. The `ci-gates` risk family was widened on 2026-09-28 (commit 05b6cf8) to cover every file under `scripts/`; when this plan ran and shipped as PR #85 on 2026-09-24, `ci-gates` meant `.github/workflows/` only, so B1's grant of `scripts/render_brand_assets.cjs`, `scripts/ux_polish_round2_browser_proof.cjs` and `scripts/r7r8_browser_proof.cjs` was standard-risk work, no senior reviewer was required, and none was appointed: R1 was an ordinary independent read-only review. This record is deliberately NOT edited to make the checker pass. Setting `senior: true` on R1, or adding a reviewer row, would assert that a senior review happened when it did not; a fabricated reviewer inside a historic record is a worse outcome than a known failing check, and the next agent to read this file should leave the failure standing. The same run also reports `open_work_overlap` for `web/src/styles.css` and `PROJECT_STATUS.md` against `origin/codex/senior-engineering-review-20260921`: those are recomputed from live git state on every run, so they describe today's branches rather than the state at dispatch, and the `plan.accepted_overlaps` field that would record an accepted overlap did not exist on 2026-09-24 either. The decision to pay this cost rather than hide it is recorded in the `claude` slot of PROJECT_STATUS.md, in the 2026-09-28 orchestration-enforcement round-two entry that names this file and docs/team-plans/2026-09-25-graphite-mint-brand.json as the deliberate over-inclusion and explains why a name-keyword allowlist was rejected. Nothing in CI is red because of this: no CI step runs the checker over committed plans.
